stem.text: Propan-1-ol can be reacted with acidified potassium dichromate(VI) to form propanoic acid, reaction 1, or propanal, reaction 2.

stem.alt: Reaction scheme: propan-1-ol (CH3CH2CH2OH) gives propanoic acid (CH3CH2COOH) by reaction 1 and propanal (CH3CH2CHO) by reaction 2; the two products are drawn as displayed formulas

stem.text: How can the reaction be carried out to ensure that reaction 2 occurs rather than reaction 1?

A.text: An excess of acidified potassium dichromate(VI) is used.

B.text: An excess of concentrated sulfuric acid is added.

C.text: The reaction mixture is distilled immediately after mixing.

D.text: The reaction mixture is heated under reflux.
